pin.note: public cert only. Never a private key. Bots and apps recompute the SHA-256 fingerprint and print PASS/FAIL + subject. No signing.

commands.GHOSTKEY: Show the official RGHOSTKEY (owner, ЯID, serial, fingerprint) and verify the bundled public cert against the pin. No signing.
commands.GHOSTKEY SHOW: Show owner, ЯID, serial and fingerprint of the official public cert.
commands.GHOSTKEY VERIFY: Recompute the SHA-256 fingerprint and check the bundled public cert against the pin. PASS/FAIL. No signing.
commands.GHOSTKEY SIGN: Handoff only: calls out to the owner's RVAULT/RWALLET Face ID, fingerprint or ASSM login. ThundR and GIZMO never sign.
commands.GHOSTKEY SEAL: Handoff only: same owner-device seal flow. Never seals here.
commands.GHOSTKEY MINT: Handoff only: same owner-device seal flow. Never mints here.

note: public cert only. Never a private key. GIZMO (in-game) and ThundR (out of game) verify and display only. Sign, seal and mint call out to the owner's existing RVAULT/RWALLET Face ID, fingerprint or ASSM login. Bots never sign.
